ns2:section.sectionText: LIS graduate students; other graduate students need permission of instructor to enroll (mwolske@illinois.edu). 2 or 4 GR hours; be sure to enroll in your desired credit amount. A non-waived course fee of $25 (field trip) will be assessed to the student's tuition and fees bill; students may incur additional expenses in relation to their individual practical engagement activities. Meets with LIS 490STU.
